items.goal: Add GET /api/catalog/items/{id:int}/brand-mates to the api group shared by versions 1.0 and 2.0 in src/Catalog.API/Apis/CatalogApi.cs. It returns 404 for an unknown id, 400 with ProblemDetails when count is outside 1-12 (default 4), and otherwise the other items of the same CatalogBrandId (excluding id itself, CatalogBrand included, ordered by Name ordinal ascending, at most count). Rebuild Catalog.API to regenerate the OpenAPI JSON files. Add CatalogService.GetBrandMates(int id) in src/WebAppComponents/Services/CatalogService.cs. In ItemPage.razor, below item-details, render <section> with the heading 'More from {item.CatalogBrand.Brand}' and a grid of CatalogListItem cards, only when the list is non-empty; a failed brand-mates call must not break the page. Style the section in ItemPage.razor.css. The UI verifier can use the default scenario for the shown case; for the hidden case it must itself create, through the Catalog API, a new brand item that is the only item of its brand, or …
